title: 49 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Dating & Romance)
description:
Learn 49 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Dating & Romance · 约会与浪漫
1:19  Success · 成功
2:53  Sports & Fitness · 运动与健身
4:19  Kindness · 善良
5:35  Strength · 力量
6:54  Hotel & Accommodation · 酒店与住宿
8:02  Hope · 希望
9:29  Family & Home · 家庭与家居

PHRASE LIST

DATING & ROMANCE · 约会与浪漫
• I brought your favorite snacks. - 我带了你最爱吃的零食。  [Wo dai le ni zui ai chi de ling shi.]
• Want to see a comedy tonight? - 今晚去看喜剧吗？  [Jin wan qu kan xi ju ma?]
• Your smile totally got me. - 你一笑我就心动了。  [Ni yi xiao wo jiu xin dong le.]
• Let’s try something new this weekend. - 这个周末我们去尝点新鲜的吧。  [Zhe ge zhou mo wo men qu chang dian xin xian de ba.]
• Should we grab dumplings after? - 吃完再去吃饺子怎么样？  [Chi wan zai qu chi jiao zi zen me yang?]
• I’m free at seven, maybe? - 我七点有空，你看行吗？  [Wo qi dian you kong, ni kan xing ma?]

SUCCESS · 成功
• Your effort is paying off right now. - 你 的 努力 正在 见效。  [Nǐ de nǔlì zhèngzài jiànxioU.]
• Stay flexible, success follows confidence. - 保持灵活，成功会靠近 自信。  [Bǎochí línghuó, chénggōng huì kào jìn zìxìn.]
• Celebrate small wins, then go again. - 把 小胜 记在心里，再出发。  [Bǎ xiǎo shèng jì zài xīnlǐ, zài chūfā.]
• Take one bold step today. - 今天 迈 出 一个 坚定 的 大步。  [Jīntiān mài chū yí ge jiāndìng de dàbù.]
• Risk a little, learn fast. - 稍微冒险，学得更快。  [Shāowēi màoxiǎn, xué de gèng kuài.]
• Turn setbacks into useful lessons. - 把 挫折 变成 有用 的 教训。  [Bǎ cuòzhé biàn chéng yǒuyòng de jiàoxùn.]

SPORTS & FITNESS · 运动与健身
• Time to move, even gently - 该动起来了 就算很轻也行  [Gāi dòng qǐlái le, jiù suàn hěn qīng yě xíng]
• I practice breathing before every set - 每一组之前我都先练呼吸  [Měi yí zǔ zhī qián wǒ dōu xiān liàn hūxī]
• Pick a target, then go steady - 先定个目标 然后稳稳地练  [Xiān dìng gè mùbiāo, ránhòu wěn wěn de liàn]
• My warm muscles feel ready now - 热身后的肌肉现在真的很到位  [Rèshēn hòu de jīròu xiànzài zhēn de hěn dào wèi]
• Focus on my posture, not ego - 姿势先到位 以后我才不逞强  [Zīshì xiān dào wèi, yǐhòu wǒ cái bù chěng qiáng]
• I’m earning sweat, one rep at a time - 我一下一下练着 挣到满身汗  [Wǒ yì xià yì xià liàn zhe, zhèng dào mǎn shēn hàn]

KINDNESS · 善良
• Thanks for including me, seriously. - 谢谢你愿意带上我，真的很暖。  [Xièxie nǐ yuànyì dài shàng wǒ, zhēn de hěn nuǎn.]
• You can have the last word. - 你先说完也没关系。  [Nǐ xiān shuō wán yě méi guānxi.]
• I won’t interrupt, I promise. - 我不打断你说话，我答应。  [Wǒ bú dǎduàn nǐ shuōhuà, wǒ dāyìng.]
• Let me carry that for you. - 我来帮你拿着吧。  [Wǒ lái bāng nǐ názhe ba.]
• It’s okay, I’ll go at your pace. - 没事的，我们慢慢来。  [Méi shì de, wǒmen màn man lái.]
• Your effort matters, I see it. - 你的努力我看见了，也记在心里。  [Nǐ de nǔlì wǒ kànjiàn le, yě jì zài xīn lǐ.]

STRENGTH · 力量
• I can do this, even slowly - 我能做到, 就算慢一点  [Wo NENG zuo dao, jiu suan MAN yi dian]
• My body rests, then I return - 我先让身体休息, 然后回来  [Wo xian rang shenti xiuxi, ranhou huilai]
• I move forward despite the noise - 我不管噪音, 继续往前走  [Wo buguan zao yin, jixu wang qian zou]
• I set one small goal today - 我今天先定一个小目标  [Wo jintian xian ding yi ge xiao mubiao]
• Break it down, then begin - 把它拆开, 然后开始  [Ba ta chai kai, ranhou kaishi]
• I ask what matters most - 我先问清楚, 什么最重要  [Wo xian wen qingchu, shenme zui zhongyao]

HOTEL & ACCOMMODATION · 酒店与住宿
• How do I check in, please? - 我怎么办理入住？  [Wo zenme banli ruzhu?]
• Is there a quiet room available? - 有安静的房间可以安排吗？  [You anjing de fangjian ke yi anpai ma?]
• Can I get an extra blanket? - 我能再要一条毯子吗？  [Wo neng zai yao yi tiao tanzi ma?]
• Where is the luggage storage? - 行李寄存在哪里？  [Xingli jicun zai nali?]
• Do you offer a hairdryer here? - 你们这里有吹风机吗？  [Nimen zheli you chuifengji ma?]
• Can I print my boarding pass? - 我可以打印登机牌吗？  [Wo keyi dayin dengji pai ma?]

HOPE · 希望
• I can hope, even today - 今天我也能抱有希望  [JINtiān wǒ yě néng bào yǒu XIWÀNG]
• Hope gives me a steadier pace - 希望让我步子更稳了  [XIwàng ràng wǒ bùzi gēng wěn le]
• I choose hope over panic - 我选择希望，不选慌张  [wǒ xuǎnzé XIWÀNG, bú xuǎn huāngzhāng]
• Hope, take the lead inside me - 希望在我心里先走一步  [XIwàng zài wǒ xīn lǐ xiān zǒu yí bù]
• I’m allowed to want better - 我可以想要更好的生活  [wǒ kěyǐ xiǎng yào gèng hǎo de shēnghuó]
• Tomorrow feels less scary now - 现在我对明天没那么害怕  [xiànzài wǒ duì MÍngtiān méi nàme hàipà]
• Hope is my quiet plan - 希望是我心里的小计划  [XIwàng shì wǒ xīn lǐ de xiǎo jìhuà]

FAMILY & HOME · 家庭与家居
• Want to come over for tea? - 你要来家里喝点茶吗？  [ni YAO lai jia li he dian CHA ma]
• Let me make your bed. - 我来帮你把床铺好。  [wo LAI bang ni ba chuang pu hao]
• Can we fix this together? - 我们一起把这事弄明白吧。  [women YI qi ba zhe shi nong ming bai ba]
